status.en: 13 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 59% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 13 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 59 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syrian forces are again reported to be moving troops and advisers toward Saudi Arabia and Yemen while Damascus denies any deployment, and a diplomatic source says military agreements with Saudi Arabia are limited to training and expertise exchange. Iranian discontent is heightening cross-border threats to Syria, according to experts. A Syrian soldier was killed and another wounded by a landmine explosion in Deir ez-Zor. Flood waters collapsed a bridge in eastern Syria, killing one person. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske styrker blir igjen rapportert å flytte tropper og rådgivere mot Saudi-Arabia og Jemen, mens Damaskus benekter enhver utplassering, og en diplomatisk kilde sier at militære avtaler med Saudi-Arabia er begrenset til trening og erfaringsutveksling. Iransk misnøye øker grenseoverskridende trusler mot Syria, ifølge eksperter. En syrisk soldat ble drept og en annen såret av en landmineeksplosjon i Deir ez-Zor. Flomvann fikk en bro i Øst-Syria til å kollapse, og én person døde. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
